dct_title_s: Enumeration districts, tracts and wards of Minneapolis as of 1940 census
dct_alternative_sm: Enumeration districts, tracts and wards of Minneapolis as of 1940 census
dct_description_sm: "W.P.A. O.P. no. 65-1-71-140. Sub project 234"; Marked in pencil on map recto and verso: "1400 / 3-31"; Population figures are hand-marked on base map. Census tract populations are shown in red ink; enumeration district populations are shown in black ink.; Base map shows points of intersection of streets and city limits.; Shows parks, cemeteries, and railroad and industrial properties.; Bodies of water are hand-colored in blue pencil.
